subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start from implicit OpenAI/Codex Realtime credential availability, or only after explicit `talk.realtime` readiness/preflight says the provider is usable?
rationale: Current docs and code intentionally allow API-key/OAuth/Codex fallback, while this report expects a local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either direction changes user-facing setup semantics.

options.title: Gate on Gateway readiness
options.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless `talk.catalog` or an equivalent Gateway preflight reports a usable Realtime provider.

options.title: Keep implicit credential activation
options.body: Treat configured OpenAI/Codex Realtime auth as sufficient and narrow follow-up work to clearer diagnostics for provider/API failures.

options.title: Require explicit Realtime config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when `talk.realtime` is explicitly configured, accepting upgrade and migration impact for existing users.

recommendation.title: Gate on Gateway readiness
recommendation.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless `talk.catalog` or an equivalent Gateway preflight reports a usable Realtime provider.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the unified Talk runtime and current OpenAI Realtime auth direction, so this is the best available owner for the product contract.
